title: MapUnite bike profile bundle
description: Schema 1.0.0. GENERATED from public/js/bikedb/bundle-contract.js by scripts/bikedb/gen-schema.mjs — do not edit by hand. Structural checks only; physics, provenance and fuel-safety rules live in validateBundle().

fuelSystem.description: fi = fuel injection (cuts fuel on overrun), carb = carburettor

flexFuel.description: Manufacturer-certified flex-fuel engine (E85/E100 capable). Absent = false

peakTorque.description: Peak net torque (engine only — no electric assist)
Peak torque; `at` says whether measured at the motor or the wheel

certifiedRange.description: Certified range per charge; `cycle` names the test cycle

finalRatio.description: Final / secondary reduction (sprockets on manual bikes, gear reduction on CVT scooters)

reductionRatio.description: Motor → wheel reduction (1 for direct hub motors)

mass.description: Vehicle mass; `basis` says kerb (fluids + fuel) or dry

obd.description: OBD stage code from the same table

image.description: Picture of this variant for the bike picker: an https URL taken from the cited source (never a guessed or constructed URL). Compiled to image_url

redlineFactor.description: Redline ÷ peak-power rpm, when redline isn't published
